description: Use when an agent needs to know whether a token on Base, BNB Chain or Ethereum can be sold before it buys. Returns a verdict from our own buy-then-sell simulation on the token's deepest pool, with the buy and sell tax measured. Also: whether a wallet transfer works, bytecode flags (mintable, blacklist, proxy, pausable, owner), where simulation and bytecode disagree, and the block. Uniswap, Aerodrome and PancakeSwap pools. No pool found is a finding; RPC failure answers 503. Costs 0.01 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

chain.description: base (default: Uniswap V2/V3/V4, Aerodrome), bsc (PancakeSwap V2/V3) or ethereum (Uniswap V2/V3)

token.description: token contract address, 0x followed by 40 hex characters
